decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY establishing that confirmation-email display is required for fiat buyers and otherwise optional.
The existing same-message FAQ MODIFY already requires the fiat-buyer section to explain that the confirmation email contains the mint number and referral code, NFT details, and dashboard link.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY containing the complete required confirmation-email contents.
Changing the certificate email's informational contents does not alter the read-only mode, PDF.js technology, or reader access points.
The confirmation-email content change does not alter the independently specified optional offline-download link or its presentation.
The About-page requirement does not expose or govern the certificate confirmation-email content list.
Requiring specified information in the confirmation email does not change wallet creation, custody, key control, or setup behavior.
The email-content decision does not change the commission amount, qualifying trigger, recipient, timing, or payment destination.
The confirmation-email content requirement does not change which book, referral-code, badge, or ticket state transfers with an NFT.
The confirmation-email content change has no effect on primary-sale revenue allocations or fiat-fee treatment.
Mentioning the referral code in fiat-buyer confirmation emails does not change any Big Block prize, ticket, draw, or funding rule.
Mentioning the referral code in fiat-buyer confirmation emails does not change any Small Block prize, ticket, draw, or funding rule.
